subject: science
name: Science
course: Light, Sound, Sky Patterns & Living Things
title: Grade 1 Science: Light, Sound, Sky Patterns & Living Things
overview: Grade 1 Science engages students in the scientific method and engineering design process across physical, life, and Earth/space sciences aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Ask scientific questions, plan and conduct controlled investigations, and analyze experimental data.
Develop and use models to describe natural systems, energy flows, and physical interactions.
Construct explanations supported by empirical evidence and scientific reasoning.
Design, test, and optimize engineering solutions to real-world technological and environmental problems.

modules.title: Waves: Light and Sound Communication
modules.description: Investigating sound through vibrating materials, exploring how light travels and illuminates objects, and communicating with signals.

topics.title: Sound Vibrations and Volume
topics.description: Testing tuning forks, string instruments, and speakers to connect vibration to sound.

topics.title: Light Beams, Shadows & Transparent Materials
topics.description: Observing how light passes through transparent, translucent, and opaque materials.

topics.title: Communicating with Light and Sound Devices
topics.description: Designing flashlights and percussion codes to transmit messages across distances.

modules.title: Plant and Animal Structures & Biomimicry
modules.description: Discovering how external physical structures help plants and animals survive, grow, and protect their offspring.

topics.title: Animal Parts for Defense and Mobility
topics.description: Analyzing claws, shells, wings, and camouflage, and engineering bio-inspired tools.

topics.title: Parent-Offspring Behaviors and Traits
topics.description: Observing how animal parents nurture their young and how young resemble parents.

modules.title: Space Systems: Patterns in the Sky
modules.description: Tracking observable cyclical patterns of the Sun, Moon, and stars across daytime and nighttime skies.

topics.title: Sunrise, Sunset & Seasonal Daylight
topics.description: Measuring daylight changes from winter to summer and tracking the solar arc.

topics.title: Moon Phases & Star Constellations
topics.description: Observing how the Moon changes shape and how constellations appear in seasons.
